# Metangy

> Metangy is the flagship model of **Medi AI**, a multilingual health AI. Ask a health question or photograph a lab report and get a clear, structured explanation in your own language. Metangy runs on 10 AI models with automatic failover, grounded in a curated medical knowledge base.

**Medi AI** is a multilingual health AI, and **Metangy** is its flagship model. Metangy is developed by **tangydust (Nirvan)**, a 14-year-old solo developer, over six months, and went live in September 2026.

## What it does

- **Medical chat** — ask any health question; Metangy detects your language and replies in it.
- **Report Lens** — photograph a lab report; on-device OCR (with automatic rotation) extracts the text and Metangy explains each value against its normal range in plain words.
- **10 AI models** — ten AI models with automatic failover, so an answer still comes if one is slow. Higher plans run more models together on each answer.
- **Curated knowledge base** — 160+ health topics and lab-report guides, with sources such as the NHS and WHO.
- **50+ languages** — all 22 official Indian languages plus major world languages, and Hinglish.
- **Voice input and read-aloud** — speak your question; have answers read aloud in a natural AI voice (with a phone-voice fallback).
- **Safety** — detects emergencies and warns immediately (112 in India); never invents unreadable values or gives dosages to self-prescribe.
- **Saved reports and chat history**, a personal **dashboard**, **coupons**, and **report-a-problem**.
- **Guest mode** — try the full app with 3 free credits, no account needed.
- **Referrals** — invite 2 friends who create an account and get the Plus plan free.
- **Installable** as a web app (PWA); a WhatsApp bot is also available.

## Pricing

A free plan with credits that refresh weekly. Paid plans add daily credits, more AI models per answer and ad-free use. Payments are handled by Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets); visitors from outside India also see an approximate price in their own currency.

## Important

Metangy provides general health information, not a medical diagnosis. In an emergency, call 112 (India) or your local emergency number.
